quote: 如果我们过去本身有一些做得不够好的地方被错误地当成了今日测试标准，而实际上我们改进后的新版本比之前的版本更好、更接近原版 PDF，这种情况下我们要大胆去做，而不是以旧的、还不够好的版本为标准。; 3 接受
english: The maintainer's standing rule (2026-10-23, relayed by the coordinator): where something we did less well before was wrongly taken as today's test standard, and the new version is in fact better and closer to the original PDF, be bold and do it, rather than take the old, not good enough version as the standard; and decision 3 ("3 接受", 2026-10-22): what fails the check is shown untranslated. The coordinator told the maintainer of this ruling and its evidence (numbers and side-by-side crops of the pages that move); no further word was needed before merge. Coverage first: every unit of the body translated but formulas and code
on: per-unit verification (pull request of feat/unit-verify, LAYOUT 16): a unit is laid only where every line it owns is in place on arXiv's PDF (the median of its matched words' offsets within 0.5 pt on its own page, or a twin of the same words but for their characters outside ASCII); the per-part share (CARRY_MIN 0.9) and the paper's share are gone; a paper of no unit laid falls back to arXiv's PDF
scope: text units left English on every target (de, es, fr, ko, ru 1 -> 3, ja 3 -> 5, zh 9 -> 72); on zh blank lines / frame 0.532 -> 0.555, frames with a blank line 21.1 -> 21.9 %, full size 96.2 -> 95.9 %, and on ko paragraph gaps tighter than the lines beside them 0.184 -> 0.186. All on the 48 pages of 4 papers where the pack's 73 units whose own lines do not all stand in place on arXiv's PDF are left the original's (1706.03762 1, 1810.04805 23, 2307.16209 47, 2609.26457 2): with those pages left out on both sides every one of these measures is equal on every target, same frames, same aggregation. The delta is this change's alone: next (6c735aab, #434/#436/#435 in) on its own pack (a) cd14a11e against this branch on pack (b) 00ee0869, the same marked originals and base pages
why: The standard is closeness to the original page, not equality with the last build. The merge base's gate draws each paper's whole layout file, so it counts as drawn the units production never drew: production's per-part rule left a part whose lines were under 90 % in place untranslated, whole (1706.03762 page 1, 1810.04805 pages 12-16, 2307.16209 pages 70-139: 328 of the pack's 1,804 units). Against what production shows today the pack draws 255 units more (1,476 -> 1,731: 279 gained, 24 lost), so coverage rises. A unit now left the original's is one whose own lines stand elsewhere on our base page than on arXiv's (another TeX Live's line breaks, lines 0.5 pt off and more, or on another page, a line of no partner): drawn, its translation would stand in a frame arXiv's original does not have; left the original's, every unit that is drawn stands where arXiv's page sets it. The frame measures move only because the drawn set changes on those pages (the page-local fill and the gaps of the units beside them): with those pages excluded they are equal
